subject: dsa
title: Design Twitter
summary: A news feed merges the newest tweets from many people in time order. Push each person's latest tweet into a max-heap keyed by timestamp, pop the newest, then push that person's next tweet so the heap stays small.
problem: getNewsFeed returns the 10 most recent tweets from a user and everyone they follow, merged by time with a max-heap keyed by timestamp. User 1 follows user 2. User 1 posted tweet 5 at time 5; user 2 posted tweet 6 at time 6 and tweet 7 at time 7.

steps.caption: The feed is the most recent tweets from self and followees, merged with a max-heap keyed by time.
Push the newest tweet from each person: time 7 from user 2 and time 5 from user 1. The root is 7.
Pop 7 into the feed, then push user 2's next tweet, 6. The heap is now 6 and 5 with root 6. The feed is [7], then popping 6 makes it [7, 6].
Pop 5 into the feed, giving [7, 6, 5]. User 1 has no more tweets, so the heap is empty.
Done. The news feed is [7, 6, 5], newest first.
